source_name: MNB Intézménykereső (market participant / institution register)
why_relevant: Authoritative list of every MNB-licensed or registered bank, financial enterprise, payment institution, e-money issuer, investment firm and fund manager in Hungary, plus cross-border passporting entities. This is the master ACTOR MAP for A5 — the universe of employers whose officer changes must then be tracked. Institution-level only; per my fetch it does not itself list executives.

source_name: MNB — Piaci szereplők keresése hub (incl. közvetítők, speciális adatbázisok, határon átnyúló tevékenységek)
why_relevant: Hub page linking the sub-registers: intermediaries (money-market and insurance agents — a large hiring/organization-change population usually invisible to press-based cells), specialised databases, and cross-border activity lists. High pointer value for widening the A5 actor universe beyond the ~30 well-known banks.

source_name: MNB — Felügyeleti hírek (supervisory news)
why_relevant: Narrative announcements of significant supervisory actions — licence grants/withdrawals, sanctions, suspension or removal of senior managers. Faster and more readable than the raw decision PDFs and often flags the most consequential leadership events.

source_name: MNB Szanálás — Határozatok (resolution-authority decisions)
why_relevant: Resolution (szanálás) decisions are the extreme end of organization change — appointment of szanálási biztos / administrators, replacement of management, transfer of business. Rare but very high-signal for A5 organization-change tracking.

source_name: MNB archívum — Hitelintézeti határozatok (legacy PSZÁF/MNB credit-institution decisions)
why_relevant: Historic archive (including PSZÁF-era H-EN-I decisions) giving multi-year backfill of executive-appointment approvals at banks and savings cooperatives — the baseline needed to compute tenure, churn rates and career paths rather than only current events.

source_name: BÉT — Kibocsátói hírek (Budapest Stock Exchange issuer disclosures)
why_relevant: Listed issuers (OTP Bank, and other financial issuers/bond issuers such as MFB) must file 'rendkívüli tájékoztatás' under Tpt. §55, which explicitly covers 'Közlemény vezető állású személyek körében bekövetkező változásról' — board and senior-management changes, with names, roles and effective dates, in a machine-fetchable PDF.

source_name: MNB Közzétételek (OAM) — officially appointed mechanism for regulated information
why_relevant: The statutory central storage mechanism where issuers and regulated entities file 'szabályozott információ' under Tpt./Bszt./Kbftv. Duplicates and sometimes exceeds BÉT coverage (includes non-BÉT-listed bond issuers such as bank subsidiaries), and gives stable downloadable document IDs. Strong cross-check for BÉT and a POINTER to issuers never covered by the press.

source_name: e-cégjegyzék (official electronic company register, Ministry of Justice)
why_relevant: Every Zrt./Kft. officer change (vezető tisztségviselő, cégjegyzésre jogosult, felügyelőbizottsági tag) must be registered within 30 days; the cégkivonat lists current and (in the paid stored extract) deleted officers with effective dates. This is the ground truth for A5 leadership-change events at every Hungarian bank, payment institution, fintech and their subsidiaries — including entities with no press coverage at all.

source_name: Cégszolgálat Online Céginformáció (OCCSZ)
why_relevant: The official paid channel of the Céginformációs Szolgálat for full and historical company extracts, including deleted (törölt) officers with their exact from/to dates — the only authoritative way to reconstruct a bank executive's tenure history from the register itself.

source_name: Céginformációs és az Elektronikus Cégeljárásban Közreműködő Szolgálat (Céginformációs Szolgálat)
why_relevant: The state body that governs company information supply; its pages document which register products exist, what each contains, pricing and reuse rules, and link the direct-announcement (közvetlen közlemény) channel. The authoritative reference for the legal/access status of every register-based source in this cell.

source_name: Cégközlöny Online — kereső (official Company Gazette search)
why_relevant: Statutory gazette publishing cégbírósági végzések: registration of new vezető tisztségviselők and supervisory-board members, deletions, seat/name changes, liquidations. Free public access by law, and it is a time-stamped EVENT STREAM (unlike the cégjegyzék, which is a state snapshot) — ideal for change detection without per-entity polling.

source_name: Cégközlöny közvetlen közlemények rendszere (CKK)
why_relevant: Channel through which companies themselves submit direct announcements to the Cégközlöny (mergers, transformations, capital changes, calls to creditors). Financial-sector reorganisations — the corporate side of 'organization changes' — surface here before or alongside the court order.

source_name: Elektronikus Beszámoló Portál (e-beszámoló, Ministry of Justice)
why_relevant: Annual accounts filed by every Hungarian company, including banks and payment institutions. The kiegészítő melléklet and the accompanying taggyűlési/alapítói határozat name the signing officers, board members and management remuneration — an annual, downloadable, name-bearing cross-check on officer identity and often on headcount (átlagos statisztikai létszám), which is a direct 'jobs' indicator.

source_name: OPTEN Cégtár / Idővonal (commercial register aggregator)
why_relevant: Commercial re-packager of the cégjegyzék with the features the official register lacks: a 'Tisztségviselők' block containing current AND deleted officers, an Idővonal (timeline) of changes, cross-company person linkage (which other boards a banker sits on), and a cégfigyelés change-monitoring/alerting service. Fastest practical route to person-level career graphs in HU banking.

source_name: Nemzeti Cégtár (OPTEN public company-profile portal)
why_relevant: Publicly viewable company profile pages derived from the register — useful for free, low-volume verification of an entity's current officers and for URL-addressable entity resolution (slug contains cégjegyzékszám).

source_name: Céginfo.hu (company data aggregator)
why_relevant: Second independent aggregator of register data with per-company officer listings; valuable as a cross-check when OPTEN and the free e-cégjegyzék disagree, and its URL structure keys on cégjegyzékszám for entity resolution.

source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár / Magyar Közlöny (njt.hu) — government decrees and MNB rendeletek
why_relevant: State-owned financial institutions (MFB, EXIM/Eximbank, MEHIB, Magyar Posta financial arms) have leadership and governance changes effected by kormányhatározat/miniszteri döntés published in Magyar Közlöny; MNB rendeletek here also define the fit-and-proper and disclosure regime (e.g. 4/2016. (III. 1.) MNB rendelet). Legally-forced pointer for the state-bank segment that BÉT does not cover.

source_name: MNB — Licensing and institution oversight (English mirror)
why_relevant: English-language mirror of the licensing framework and market-participant search. Lower detail than the Hungarian pages (many decision documents are HU-only) but useful for terminology mapping ('vezető állású személy' -> 'senior manager / key function holder') and for briefing non-Hungarian analysts.

source_name: MBH Bank — Felügyeleti határozatok (issuer-side publication of supervisory decisions)
why_relevant: Example of the issuer-side statutory duty: supervised banks publish the MNB decisions concerning them on their own sites. Confirms that a per-bank 'felügyeleti határozatok' / 'közzétételek' page pattern exists and is worth enumerating across the whole HU bank list — often faster and more complete for a single institution than the MNB search.

source_name: MFB Zrt. — Alapszabály / corporate governance disclosures
why_relevant: State development bank publishes its statutes and governance documents defining board composition and appointment authority; combined with its BÉT bond-issuer disclosures it makes MFB's board changes fully traceable. Template for the other state-owned institutions (EXIM, MEHIB).

source_name: K-Monitor adatbázis — public-institution and state-bank entity dossiers
why_relevant: NGO-run tagged archive linking named individuals to state financial institutions across years of press and official documents. Not a primary register, but an efficient POINTER to the underlying official documents and to persons/roles at state banks that other cells would miss.

source_name: Magyar Közlöny (Hungarian Official Gazette) – online edition
why_relevant: Primary legal publication venue for government decrees, ministerial decisions and the establishment/restructuring of state-controlled financial bodies (MFB, Eximbank/MEHIB, MÁK, Diákhitel). Appointments and organisational mandates of state entities are legally anchored here.

source_name: Hivatalos Értesítő (annex to Magyar Közlöny) – ministerial instructions / SZMSZ
why_relevant: Where ministerial 'utasítás' documents publish the Organisational and Operational Rules (SZMSZ) of state bodies such as Magyar Államkincstár — these literally define org structure, number of deputy presidents, and named leadership posts. The single best structural-change source for state financial bodies.

source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (NJT) – ministerial instructions database
why_relevant: Consolidated, searchable text of NGM/PM ministerial instructions establishing SZMSZ of MÁK and other state financial bodies (e.g. 3/2025. (I. 30.) NGM utasítás). Easier to diff over time than gazette PDFs.

source_name: Céginformációs portál (Igazságügyi Minisztérium) – company search
why_relevant: Official entry point to company data for state-owned financial entities; resolves exact legal names, registration numbers and current officers — the key that makes Cégközlöny monitoring precise, and reveals subsidiary/holding structure changes.

source_name: Közbeszerzési Értesítő (Public Procurement Bulletin, KÖZBESZERZÉSI HATÓSÁG)
why_relevant: All national-threshold tenders by state-controlled financial bodies are published here — consultancy, HR/staffing, recruitment, IT development and outsourcing notices reveal org-change programmes, headcount plans and the winning suppliers. Also a pointer into supplier names.

source_name: Közbeszerzési Hatóság – Adatbázisok / open data
why_relevant: Structured databases and downloadable datasets over procurement notices and contracts — the machine-readable route into the same corpus as the Értesítő, plus contract-award data that names suppliers of HR/IT services to state financial bodies.

source_name: EKR – Elektronikus Közbeszerzési Rendszer
why_relevant: The operational e-procurement platform where procedures actually run; since mid-2024 it offers structured search by CPV code, subject and place of performance. Procedure documents (technical specs, scope of work) are far richer than the gazette notice and often describe target operating models and staffing.
